keystore_note: The repository filesystem in this environment (fuseblk) reports every file as 0777 and does not honour chmod, so the vetted protected_signing loader refuses to read a key from the in-tree location.  The private keystore is therefore placed on a filesystem that does enforce 0600/0700.  Only the PUBLIC trust material lives in the repository.
note: Each issuer key was generated with Ed25519PrivateKey.generate() at setup time and is stored 0600 inside a 0700 directory.  No key is derived from a public session id, task seed, or any other public constant.
